dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How's life been treating you recently, Mr. Chicherin?

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking, Lady Nefer. Life's been ticking along as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Good to hear — "as usual" is the best we can ask for.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I wish you all the best, Mr. Chicherin.
